body:
Proposed after e-prior-art. Two of the three surfaces exist and are better than anything we would write first: zp for choosing (fzf, repos, previews, labels, --print for composition) and pi-zmx for agents. Both read labels and neither writes them, and neither makes a session survive its creator.

So zmux ships exactly the missing pieces:
- `zmux` = `za` + naming + labels at creation (d-birth), with the launcher as data.
- the vocabulary document (d-vocab), which is what makes zp's label search and any reader useful.
- the Emacs plugin, because that surface is personal and the existing one is generic.
And it composes with the rest through the interface they already speak: names, labels, `zmx ls` fields, and `zp --print`-style machine output where a caller needs it.

Rejected: our own picker (zp exists), our own agent tools (pi-zmx exists), our own `ls` as a primary surface — a reader is still wanted, but `zmx ls` plus a filter may be enough, which q-v0 now has to settle honestly.
title: Do not rebuild what exists; ship the missing birth path and convention
